## TL;DR

I drove the task-worktree app at desktop and phone sizes, reviewed the screenshot matrix in light and dark themes, and inspected the bottom of the long pages. The corrected matrix showed no horizontal overflow or reproducible layout defect. At 390px, Work scrolls inside `.main` through its `.mobile-work` child; that scrollport reached its exact end, and the final card remained above the fixed dock with bottom clearance. I did not change app source.

The report and reproduction commands are in `docs/qa/2026-11-web-qa-pass.md`. I filed follow-ups #1163 (Checks tab capture/interaction stall), #1164 (authenticated Secrets verification), and #1165 (Agents authentication error guidance), each with a screenshot. These are verification tasks: the no-auth 401 and absent local Cursor credentials do not alone prove product regressions. `REPOOS_CHECK_CHANGED=main repoos check` passed after the documentation was added.

## Work and rationale

The app was served only from this task worktree with `just serve-noauth 7272`. I used Playwright and the task evidence under `.repoos/qa/1157/`; no Nick desktop or unrelated windows were used, and the served checkout was not used. The screenshot matrix covers Control, Inputs, Work Board and Pipeline routes, task drawer, Stories, Checks, Releases, Deployments, Dev, Secrets, Agents, Context Docs/Skills/Discover/History, and Settings General/Notifications/Security/Advanced/Import Export/Support/TOML/Themes at 1440, 390 and 320px in light and dark themes. Contact sheets for every matrix capture were inspected. The release cut panel was additionally opened in a safe `release:cutReady` fixture at all widths and themes; I did not publish.

For the requested mobile Work check, I revisited `/work?view=board` at 390px and inspected the bottom screenshot. `.main` is the fixed layout shell; `.mobile-work` is the scrollable child inside it. After cards settled, its `scrollTop` was 3686px with a scrollable distance of 3686px, leaving zero remaining. The bottom screenshot shows the final card entirely above the fixed tab dock, with visible clearance. The floating heads control was outside the card area at the scroll endpoint. The phone route displays the mobile queue even when Pipeline is requested; the desktop Pipeline view was separately captured at 1440px.

The task drawer opened and closed, and Task, PM, Dev, Review, Changes, Tokens and Debug tabs were selected. New task, input and story panels were opened and dismissed without submitting. The four Checks tabs were not all verified: the repeated tab-and-screenshot run slowed after capturing Now at 390px and was stopped. Follow-up #1163 is explicit that this may be a browser-capture harness stall, not a confirmed app fault.

## Approaches tried

I compared the route matrix’s viewport and document widths, inspected all contact sheets, and ran a dedicated bottom-scroll pass at 390px light theme. Since Work loads cards after navigation, I waited for content and repeated the scroll before recording the end position. I then ran a focused Playwright measurement for `.main` and its scrollable descendants to verify the exact Work scroll region and capture the bottom state. For release UI, I used a synthetic ready fixture so the cut form could be checked without meeting real release preconditions or changing release state.

## Challenges and blockers

In the auth-less run, `GET /api/project-environments` returned 401 and Secrets showed a failure state. The route requires a signed-in user, so this run cannot establish authenticated behavior. Agents showed missing authentication for the configured local Cursor CLI; no valid test credential was available. Follow-ups #1164 and #1165 request verification in suitable environments and avoid treating these states as confirmed regressions.

The Checks tab matrix slowed during repeated screenshots and remained incomplete. The default Checks route itself is captured at all requested widths and themes. The release entry point is disabled on this feature branch by its preconditions, so only the panel opened by the safe ready fixture was examined. I did not submit actions that publish releases, deploy, remove credentials, or create records. No clear small UI defect was found to fix, so no source regression test was appropriate.

## Key learnings

The narrow Work screen intentionally uses a single-column queue, with scrolling in `.mobile-work` under `.main`; direct measurement and the bottom screenshot confirm the fixed dock does not obscure the last card. Screenshot coverage can reveal responsive layout in an auth-less server, but Secrets and configured-agent behavior still require appropriate credentials. The dedicated QA record now preserves the page/width/theme matrix, observations, follow-up tasks and reproduction commands in the repository. The checked tree passed the scoped RepoOS build, test validation and UI smoke gate.
